title: Forecasting Weather-Driven Price Dynamics Across Sri Lankan Tea Market Catalogues
abstract: arXiv:2608.24894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Colombo Tea Auction (CTA) plays a vital role in determining global tea prices, yet the relationship between local weather conditions and price behavior across different tea catalogues has not been thoroughly explored. In this study, we develop a novel, structured dataset by extracting information from 105 weekly broker reports spanning late 2023 to 2026, and combined with region-specific weather data. Our analysis focuses on four main tea catalogues of Sri Lankan tea: High Grown, Low Grown, Off-Grade, and Dust. To better understand the factors influencing tea prices, we apply Granger causality analysis alongside tree-based machine learning models: Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Gradient Boosting. Our results show that while market dynamics are primary drivers, weather conditions also have significant effects. Notably, Low Grown tea shows strong sensitivity to precipitation and sunshine duration (p<0.05) across 1-3-week lags.

translated_title: 预测斯里兰卡茶叶市场目录中天气驱动的价格动态
translated_abstract: 科伦坡茶叶拍卖会（CTA）在决定全球茶叶价格中扮演着关键角色，但当地天气条件与不同茶叶目录价格行为之间的关系尚未被深入探讨。在本研究中，我们通过提取2023年末至2026年间105份每周经纪人报告的信息，并结合特定地区的天气数据，开发了一个新颖的结构化数据集。我们的分析聚焦于斯里兰卡茶叶的四个主要目录：高地茶、低地茶、次级茶和粉末茶。为了更好地理解影响茶叶价格的因素，我们应用了格兰杰因果分析以及基于树的机器学习模型：随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM和梯度提升。我们的结果显示，虽然市场动态是主要驱动因素，但天气条件也产生显著影响。值得注意的是，低地茶在1-3周的滞后期内对降水和日照时长表现出较强的敏感性（p<0.05）。
tldr: 本研究构建了结合天气数据的斯里兰卡茶叶拍卖结构化数据集，发现低地茶价格对降水和日照时长在1-3周滞后期内有显著敏感性，而市场动态仍是主要驱动因素。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a structured dataset combining weather data with Sri Lankan tea auction records, revealing that Low Grown tea prices show significant sensitivity to precipitation and sunshine duration at 1-3 week lags, while market dynamics remain the primary driver.
